docs.summary: A single unit of work in a build.
docs.remarks:
Operations never carry payload bytes. A build can produce tens of gigabytes, so content arrives through a stream opened at execution time rather than sitting in the plan.

Operations yielded within one stage are independent by contract and may run concurrently in any order. Anything with a dependency belongs in a later stage.
